caseName: Dole v. Railway Labor Executives' Ass'n
caseNameFull: Dole, Secretary of Transportation v. Railway Labor Executives' Assn.

opinions.text: Application of the Solicitor General to vacate a stay entered January 3, 1986, by the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, presented to Justice Rehnquist, and by him referred to the Court, granted.
